cors.correction: supported; Moodle sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for web-service requests when needed, although a proxy, firewall, or web-server module can remove it

description.correction: Moodle Web Services are site-specific, but deployments may be self-hosted, hosted directly by Moodle through MoodleCloud, or hosted by a Moodle Certified Partner or Service Provider.

notes: HTTP 0 is expected because the base URL contains a placeholder rather than a resolvable host. The entry fails because CORS is documented as supported and the description incorrectly excludes first-party MoodleCloud hosting. Moodle 4.1 also moved XML-RPC web services out of core into a separate plugin. Official sources did not establish the claimed global rate-limit policy or the complete no-quota wording.
